dialogues.jp:
ぷらぷら商店街を歩いていると、ふいに後ろか
ら肩を叩かれた。
dialogues.en:
As I wandered aimlessly around the shopping district, I felt
a knock on my shoulder.
dialogues.text:
As I wandered aimlessly around the shopping district, I felt
a knock on my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よ、朝倉。暇そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Asakura. You look free."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Asakura. You look free."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「別にそういうわけじゃ……これからどこへ行
　こうかと、綿密な計画を練っていたところだ」
dialogues.en:
"Not really... I actually have a painfully detailed schedule
of which places I loiter at, by the minute."
dialogues.text:
"Not really... I actually have a painfully detailed schedule
of which places I loiter at, by the minute."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そういうのを暇って言うんだろ」
dialogues.en: "What Suginami said, basically."
dialogues.text: "What Suginami said, basically."

dialogues.jp: 杉並の後ろから顔を出した工藤が苦笑する。
dialogues.en: Right after Suginami came Kudou, smiling wryly.
dialogues.text: Right after Suginami came Kudou, smiling wryly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうだ、朝倉？　久方ぶりに｛エアホッケー／肉弾戦｝といかん
　か」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura, how about a game of air hockey? We haven't played
that in a long time."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura, how about a game of air hockey? We haven't played
that in a long time."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「｛エアホッケー／肉弾戦｝ねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Air hockey, huh."
dialogues.text: "Air hockey, huh."

dialogues.jp: 最近身体動かしてないからな〜。
dialogues.en: I don't feel like moving around a lot~.
dialogues.text: I don't feel like moving around a lot~.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、また『かったりぃ』が出るか？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, another "how troublesome" from you, I bet?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm, another "how troublesome" from you, I bet?"

dialogues.jp:
ニヤニヤと笑う杉並、俺は、なんだかよく分か
らんが悔しい気持ちになって言い返した。
dialogues.en:
Suginami grinned widely at me. His words somehow vexed me,
and I decided to take up his offer.
dialogues.text:
Suginami grinned widely at me. His words somehow vexed me,
and I decided to take up his offer.

dialogues.jp: 「……誰が！　よし、受けてやろうじゃねーか」
dialogues.en: "...No way! I accept your challenge."
dialogues.text: "...No way! I accept your challenge."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「うむ、それでこそ｛おとこ／漢｝というものよ。工藤、公
　平を期すためだ。ジャッジを頼むぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Mm, now that's more like a man! Kudou, you're a fair
person. I'd leave the judging to you."
dialogues.text:
"Mm, now that's more like a man! Kudou, you're a fair
person. I'd leave the judging to you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「は！？　お、俺が？」
dialogues.en: "Hah!? M, me?"
dialogues.text: "Hah!? M, me?"

dialogues.jp:
いきなり名指しで審判に抜擢された工藤が目を
しばたかせる。
dialogues.en:
Being appointed as judge rather abruptly, Kudou looked at us
in surprise.
dialogues.text:
Being appointed as judge rather abruptly, Kudou looked at us
in surprise.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだな、我ら共通の友人たるお前なら、厳
　正に勝負を見張ってくれるだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, since you're a common friend, we can expect complete
impartiality from you."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, since you're a common friend, we can expect complete
impartiality from you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「なんでそうなるかな……べつに、フツーに順
　番で遊べばいいじゃないか。ゲームなんだし」
dialogues.en:
"Even so... it's just a game, why are you two so serious
about it?"
dialogues.text:
"Even so... it's just a game, why are you two so serious
about it?"

dialogues.jp:
ちっちっち、と指を振る俺と杉並の仕草が見事
にユニゾンする。
dialogues.en:
Tsk tsk tsk, Suginami and I waved our fingers at Kudou in
perfect unison.
dialogues.text:
Tsk tsk tsk, Suginami and I waved our fingers at Kudou in
perfect unison.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「分かっとらんな。遊びに本気を出してこそ大
　人の男というものだ」
dialogues.en:
"You don't understand. A true man treats everything he does
seriously!"
dialogues.text:
"You don't understand. A true man treats everything he does
seriously!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうとも！　なぁ、友よ」
dialogues.en: "Indeed, my friend!"
dialogues.text: "Indeed, my friend!"

dialogues.jp: 俺と杉並はがしりと腕を組み合った。
dialogues.en: Our arms joined in unity.
dialogues.text: Our arms joined in unity.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……ユルいんだか熱いんだか。俺、未だ
　にお前らがよく分からないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Haah... one time cool as ice, another hot-blooded. I'd
never understand you two."
dialogues.text:
"Haah... one time cool as ice, another hot-blooded. I'd
never understand you two."

dialogues.jp:
困ったように溜息をつく工藤を引き摺るように
して、俺達はゲーセンへと向かった。
dialogues.en:
He released a long sigh as we dragged him to the game
center.
dialogues.text:
He released a long sigh as we dragged him to the game
center.

dialogues.jp: ◆｛エアホッケー／肉弾戦｝◆
dialogues.en: ◆Air Hockey◆
dialogues.text: ◆Air Hockey◆

dialogues.jp: 杉並から｛エアホッケー／肉弾戦｝の勝負を持ちかけられた。
dialogues.en: Suginami challenged me to a battle of air hockey.
dialogues.text: Suginami challenged me to a battle of air hockey.

dialogues.jp: 望むところである。
dialogues.en: As he wished.
dialogues.text: As he wished.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺と杉並は強制的に審判に抜擢した工
藤を、引き摺るように、｛ゲーセン／戦場｝へと向かったのだっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Once that was decided, we dragged Kudou along with us to the
game center, forcing him to be our judge.
dialogues.text:
Once that was decided, we dragged Kudou along with us to the
game center, forcing him to be our judge.
